hook: Your falling space station can earn you a littering fine.
title: A town fined NASA $400 for littering
description:
When Skylab fell on Western Australia in 1979, the town of Esperance fined NASA 400 dollars for littering. The fine was finally paid in 2009. Part of the series 'If You Were in Space'.

#Shorts #Skylab #SpaceFacts
comment_prompt: Would you have paid it? Yes or no
